title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,051–2,100 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Our software development project will launch in the fourth quarter.
examples.zh: 我們的軟體開發專案將於第四季度正式上線。

examples.en: Financial analysts project a ten percent growth in smartphone exports next year.
examples.zh: 財務分析師樂觀預測，明年智慧型手機的出口總量將迎來百分之十的顯著成長。

examples.en: The projector beam projected the architectural blueprint onto the conference wall.
examples.zh: 投影機的光束將這份精密的建築施工設計藍圖清晰投影在會議室大白牆上。

examples.en: The project manager ensures team members deliver tasks on time.
examples.zh: 專案經理確保所有團隊成員如期交付工作任務。

examples.en: An agile project manager facilitates daily standup meetings to remove technical roadblocks.
examples.zh: 一位敏捷專案經理每日召開晨間站立會議，主動協助工程團隊排除技術障礙。

examples.en: Strong negotiation skills help the project manager balance competing budget priorities.
examples.zh: 沉著老練的協商溝通手腕，協助專案經理在相互競爭的多項預算優先級中取得平衡。

examples.en: Completing the app user testing is a critical project milestone.
examples.zh: 完成應用程式的使用者測試是一項關鍵的專案里程碑。

examples.en: Reaching their tenth wedding anniversary was an emotional milestone for the couple.
examples.zh: 攜手迎來結婚十週年紀念日，對這對恩愛夫妻而言是一個充滿感觸的重大人生里程碑。

examples.en: The construction team celebrated reaching the tunneling breakthrough milestone.
examples.zh: 工程營造團隊在隧道全線順利貫通的關鍵里程碑時刻，現場開香檳歡慶重大勝利。

examples.en: We worked late into the evening to meet the project deadline.
examples.zh: 我們加班到深夜以趕上專案的截止期限。

examples.en: The client agreed to extend the submission deadline by three business days.
examples.zh: 客戶通情達理地同意將專案成果的提交截止期限寬限順延三個工作天。

examples.en: Setting realistic deadlines prevents employee burnout while maintaining quality.
examples.zh: 設定切實可行的交付截稿日期，能在確保產出品管水準的同時防範團隊身心耗竭。

examples.en: Check the weekly flight schedule before planning your business trip.
examples.zh: 在規劃商務出差前先核對每週航班時刻表。

examples.en: Despite heavy monsoon rains, the bridge construction remained strictly on schedule.
examples.zh: 儘管遭遇連綿豪雨侵襲，跨海大橋的橋樑鋼構興建工程依然嚴格維持在預定進度上。

examples.en: Let's schedule a Zoom call for tomorrow morning to review the draft contract.
examples.zh: 咱們安排在明天早晨進行一場 Zoom 視訊會議，逐條審查合約初稿條款細節。

examples.en: The event director coordinated with caterers, sound crews, and hosts.
examples.zh: 活動總監與外燴廠商、音響團隊及主持人密切協調。

examples.en: Rescue helicopters coordinated closely with ground troops during the search operation.
examples.zh: 搜救直升機在深山搜救行動中，與地面挺進的特搜部隊保持著極為緊密的空地協同。

examples.en: A color consultant helped coordinate the furniture colors with the living room walls.
examples.zh: 色彩搭配顧問專業指導，協助將家具軟件色調與客廳主牆壁紙完美整合搭配。

examples.en: Seamless cross-department coordination ensures the product launch succeeds.
examples.zh: 各部門間無縫的協調配合確保了新產品發布會圓滿成功。

examples.en: Playing competitive badminton requires outstanding hand-eye athletic coordination.
examples.zh: 參與高強度羽球競賽，需要選手具備無比敏捷、精準出色的手眼肌肉協調能力。

examples.en: International disaster relief missions require high-level logistical coordination.
examples.zh: 跨國跨洲的國際災難人道救援行動，極度仰賴最高層級的後勤物流統籌協同配合。

examples.en: Taiwanese engineers collaborated with global designers on the laptop.
examples.zh: 台灣工程師與全球設計師通力合作研發這款筆記型電腦。

examples.en: Two university research labs will collaborate on an innovative cancer therapy study.
examples.zh: 兩所國立大學尖端實驗室將攜手合作，共同投入一項開創性的癌症免疫療法研究。

examples.en: The famous indie band collaborated with a classical string quartet on their new album.
examples.zh: 這支獨立樂團在發行的新專輯中，特邀古典弦樂四重奏大師跨界合作錄音。

examples.en: Effective cross-cultural collaboration boosts creative innovation.
examples.zh: 高效的跨文化合作能激發出豐沛的創意思維與創新。

examples.en: The new electric scooter is the fruit of close collaboration between two tech firms.
examples.zh: 這款嶄新的智慧聯網電動機車，是兩大科技巨擘歷時兩年密切通力協作的璀璨結晶。

examples.en: Online document editing tools facilitate real-time collaboration among remote teams.
examples.zh: 線上即時共同編輯工具，為分散全球各地的跨國遠端團隊提供了無縫即時協作體驗。

examples.en: A cross-functional team combining marketing, engineering, and sales was formed.
examples.zh: 公司組建了一個結合行銷、研發工程與業務的跨職能專案團隊。

examples.en: Cross-functional workshops break down corporate silos and accelerate product delivery.
examples.zh: 定期舉辦跨職能專題研討會能有效打破部門間的本位主義穀倉，加速產品迭代交付。

examples.en: Agile product squads rely on daily cross-functional communication between UX and backend teams.
examples.zh: 敏捷產品開發小隊極度仰賴使用者經驗設計師與後端工程團隊間緊密的每日跨職能溝通。

words.definition: 利害關係人；利益相關方

examples.en: We presented quarterly results to key company stakeholders and investors.
examples.zh: 我們向公司核心利害關係人與投資者簡報了季度營運成果。

examples.en: City planners organized public hearings to consult all community stakeholders on the transit line.
examples.zh: 都市計畫規劃師召開了多場公開公聽會，就新捷運路線廣泛徵詢所有社區利害關係人。

examples.en: Balancing the diverse expectations of company stakeholders requires transparent governance.
examples.zh: 妥善平衡企業各方利益相關人相異的期待與訴求，需要落實公開透明的公司治理。

examples.en: The primary business objective is to expand market share in Southeast Asia.
examples.zh: 首要的商業目標是拓展在東南亞地區的市場佔有率。

examples.en: A fair judge must evaluate case evidence from a completely objective viewpoint.
examples.zh: 一位公正無私的優秀法官，必須以完全超然客觀的中立視角全面審視全案各項證物。

examples.en: Clear strategic objectives give teams focus and direction during quarterly planning.
examples.zh: 清晰明確的戰略經營目標，能在每季規劃會議中賦予全體團隊無比專注的衝刺方向。

examples.en: Achieving a 20% user growth rate is our main marketing KPI.
examples.zh: 達成 20% 的使用者成長率是我們行銷團隊的核心 KPI。

examples.en: The customer service team tracks ticket resolution speed as a primary KPI.
examples.zh: 線上客服團隊將客服工單的平均問題排查處理時長，列為核心考核的重要關鍵績效指標。

examples.en: Every employee sat down with their manager to review quarterly KPI achievements.
examples.zh: 每一位員工在季度末均與直屬主管一對一深入面談，逐項檢視個人的季度 KPI 達成率。

examples.en: The team lead sent out the meeting agenda one day in advance.
examples.zh: 團隊主管提前一天發送了會議議程給所有與會者。

examples.en: The first item on today's agenda is the annual marketing budget review.
examples.zh: 今天會議議程上排定討論的第一項核心議題，是全公司年度市場行銷預算審查案。

examples.en: Setting a focused agenda keeps executive boardroom meetings efficient and concise.
examples.zh: 事先擬定綱舉目張的精準會議議程，能確保高層董事會會議始終保持高效且言之有物。

examples.en: The administrative assistant took detailed meeting minutes during the board meeting.
examples.zh: 行政助理在董事會會議期間詳實記錄了會議紀錄。

examples.en: Meeting minutes must be circulated to all participants within twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 按照規範，正式的會議紀錄應於散會後的二十四小時內發送傳閱給所有與會人員確認。

examples.en: Check the official meeting minutes to confirm who volunteered to coordinate the event.
examples.zh: 查閱正式歸檔的會議紀錄，即可清楚確認當初究竟是由誰自願負責統籌這次大型活動。

examples.en: Let's sit together and brainstorm catchy campaign slogans for the brand.
examples.zh: 大家一起坐下來，為品牌腦力激盪出吸睛好記的行銷標語吧。

examples.en: The design team gathered on comfy couches to brainstorm user interface improvements.
examples.zh: 產品體驗設計團隊圍坐在舒適的沙發上，一同腦力激盪如何進一步優化使用者介面。

examples.en: A productive brainstorming session welcomes unconventional ideas without premature judgment.
examples.zh: 一場卓有成效的腦力激盪發想會，應當包容各種跳脫框架的大膽創意且絕不預設立場。

examples.en: Her slide presentation on sustainable green tech impressed the audience.
examples.zh: 她關於綠色永續科技的投影片簡報給全場聽眾留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: The student practiced her oral presentation five times in front of the mirror.
examples.zh: 這位同學在鏡子前反覆認真模擬練習了整整五遍，為自己的口頭報告做足了準備。

examples.en: The CEO delivered a keynote product presentation that captured global media headlines.
examples.zh: 執行長在年度全球新品發表會上發表了主旨演說，強勢佔據了各大國際媒體頭版頭條。

examples.en: The keynote presenter delivered an inspiring speech on AI trends.
examples.zh: 主講人就人工智慧最新趨勢發表了一場振奮人心的專題演說。

examples.en: A polished presenter engages the audience with relatable stories and humor.
examples.zh: 一位極具台風魅力的專業簡報演講者，懂得透過引發共鳴的生活故事與幽默抓住全場目光。

examples.en: The television presenter welcomed famous chefs from across the world to the cooking show.
examples.zh: 電視美食節目當家主持人熱情開場，隆重歡迎來自世界各地的頂級名廚蒞臨料理爭霸戰。

examples.en: Keep text concise on each PowerPoint slide to maintain audience focus.
examples.zh: 每張簡報投影片上的文字應保持簡潔，以維持聽眾的專注度。

examples.en: Children laughed joyfully as they sped down the spiral playground slide.
examples.zh: 小朋友們在一圈又一圈的螺旋溜滑梯上飛速滑下，發出歡快開懷的陣陣銀鈴笑聲。

examples.en: Slide your finger across the glass touchscreen to browse the next photo.
examples.zh: 在手機光滑的玻璃觸控螢幕上輕輕滑動手指，即可流暢切換瀏覽下一張相片。

examples.en: Create a structured presentation outline before designing graphic slides.
examples.zh: 在設計美化投影片之前，請先擬定結構嚴謹的簡報大綱。

examples.en: The professor outlined three core hypotheses that form the foundation of the research.
examples.zh: 講座教授條理分明地概述了支撐本項重大研究計畫的三個核心關鍵理論假設。

examples.en: The mountain’s jagged outline was silhouetted sharply against the orange twilight sky.
examples.zh: 崇山峻嶺險峻嶙峋的奇特山脊輪廓線，在夕陽橘紅色晚霞的映襯下勾勒出壯麗剪影。

examples.en: Using bullet points makes complex information easier to digest.
examples.zh: 使用項目符號條列要點能讓複雜資訊更易於消化理解。

examples.en: Summarize each product feature in one clear bullet point on your sales sheet.
examples.zh: 在產品銷售型錄單張上，用簡潔明確的一行項目符號條列歸納每項獨家功能特點。

examples.en: Recruiters appreciate resumes that use clean bullet points to outline achievements.
examples.zh: 人資招募經理極度偏好採用乾淨條列式項目符號、條理陳述實質戰功成就的求職履歷。

words.definition: 視覺輔助工具（圖表、實物）

examples.en: Using infographics as visual aids helps clarify financial data.
examples.zh: 將資訊圖表作為視覺輔助工具能幫助釐清財務數據。

examples.en: The biology teacher brought physical plant models to class as interactive visual aids.
examples.zh: 生物老師特別將精緻的實體植物解剖模型帶入課堂，作為生動互動的視覺輔助教具。

examples.en: Effective visual aids support your speech without cluttering the screen with excess text.
examples.zh: 真正高明的視覺輔助工具能有力烘托演講主旨，而不會用密密麻麻的文字塞爆畫面。

examples.en: The sales chart shows rapid revenue growth over the past six months.
examples.zh: 銷售圖表顯示過去六個月以來營業額呈現快速成長。

examples.en: Navigators charted a safe maritime route around dangerous rocky shoals.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的遠洋航海領航員在精密海圖上繪製出一條繞開暗礁淺灘的平安航線。

examples.en: The catchy Taiwanese pop song remained at the top of the music charts for eight weeks.
examples.zh: 這首旋律洗腦的台灣本土流行金曲連續八週蟬聯各大數位音樂排行榜冠軍寶座。

examples.en: The line graph illustrates temperature changes throughout the four seasons.
examples.zh: 折線走勢圖說明了一年四季的氣溫變化。

examples.en: Plot your lab measurement data points on the coordinate graph carefully.
examples.zh: 請將你在物理實驗中親自量測到的各項數據點，工整標註繪製在坐標走勢圖上。

examples.en: The performance graph revealed a direct correlation between study hours and exam scores.
examples.zh: 學生課業表現走勢圖清晰揭示出，平時投入讀書的時數與期末成績呈現高度正相關。

examples.en: The colorful pie chart clearly shows the percentage of market share.
examples.zh: 色彩鮮明的圓餅圖清楚呈現了各大品牌的市場佔有率百分比。

examples.en: An intuitive pie chart breaks down monthly household expenses into rent, food, and savings.
examples.zh: 一張一目了然的圓餅圖將家庭每月支出精準拆解為房租、伙食費與定期儲蓄三大塊。

examples.en: The government report included a pie chart depicting the island's energy generation mix.
examples.zh: 能源主管機關的年度報告中附有一張圓餅圖，生動展示了全島當前各類發電結構佔比。

examples.en: A bar chart is great for comparing annual output across factories.
examples.zh: 長條圖非常適合用來比較各工廠之間的年度產量差異。

examples.en: The vertical bar chart compares monthly rainfall across six administrative districts.
examples.zh: 這張垂直長條圖精準對比了全市六大行政區在過去一整年當中的各月份降雨量分佈。

examples.en: Color-coded bar charts allow audience members to absorb comparative statistics instantly.
examples.zh: 採用不同顏色標記的長條統計圖，能讓現場聽眾在短短數秒內迅速消化吸收對比數據。

examples.en: Video shorts are a booming social media trend among teenagers.
examples.zh: 短影音是當前在青少年群體中迅速爆紅的社群媒體潮流趨勢。

examples.en: Remote working arrangements are becoming a long-term trend in global enterprise.
examples.zh: 居家遠端或混合辦公模式正逐漸成為全球跨國企業不可逆轉的長期人力資源趨勢。

examples.en: News about the solar eclipse began to trend rapidly on social media across Asia.
examples.zh: 關於百年一遇罕見日全食的天文奇景快訊，迅速在亞洲各大社群平台上掀起洗版熱搜潮流。

examples.en: Electric vehicle sales have shown a steady upward trend this decade.
examples.zh: 近十年來電動車的銷售量呈現穩步上升的增長趨勢。

examples.en: The helicopter climbed upward through the dense alpine fog toward safety.
examples.zh: 搜救直升機穿透層層高山濃霧筆直向上爬升，朝向空曠安全的高空空域飛去。

examples.en: Expanding your vocational skills creates strong upward career mobility over time.
examples.zh: 持續不斷地自我進修精進職業專業技能，長遠來看能為你帶來強大的向上流動升遷契機。

examples.en: Raw material prices experienced a sharp downward trend this quarter.
examples.zh: 原物料價格在該季度經歷了急遽的下滑走勢。

examples.en: The roller coaster plunged downward at dizzying speed, making riders scream.
examples.zh: 雲霄飛車以令人目眩神迷的驚人高速由最高點向下垂直俯衝，令所有遊客放聲尖叫。

examples.en: Poor cash flow can push a struggling business into a dangerous downward spiral.
examples.zh: 長期現金流枯竭且債台高築，極易將一家營運困難的中小企業拖入危險的惡性下滑螺旋。

examples.en: Gasoline prices fluctuate depending on global crude oil supplies.
examples.zh: 汽油價格隨著全球原油供應狀況而上下波動。

examples.en: Mountain temperatures fluctuate dramatically between sunny noon and chilly midnight.
examples.zh: 高山地區的氣溫在艷陽高照的正午與寒氣逼人的深夜之間，往往呈現極大的劇烈溫差波動。

examples.en: Currency exchange rates fluctuate daily in response to international trade data.
examples.zh: 各國外匯匯率隨著國際經貿數據指標與央行利率決策的公布，每日都在金融市場劇烈起伏。

examples.en: Good managers delegate daily tasks so they can focus on strategy.
examples.zh: 優秀的管理者懂得授權分派日常瑣事，以便全神貫注於策略佈局。

examples.en: Hundreds of international delegates attended the United Nations climate conference.
examples.zh: 來自世界各國的數百位官方代表團代表，齊聚一堂出席了聯合國氣候變遷大會。

examples.en: You cannot do everything alone; learn to delegate responsibilities to your capable deputies.
examples.zh: 你不可能事必躬親凡事一人扛；學會將具體職責適度授權分派給得力副手是關鍵修煉。

examples.en: Effective task delegation improves team efficiency and trust.
examples.zh: 有效的任務授權委派能提高團隊效率並建立彼此互信。

examples.en: A prestigious international trade delegation visited Hsinchu Science Park yesterday.
examples.zh: 一個由多國政商領袖組成的高規格國際經貿代表團，於昨日親赴新竹科學園區參訪交流。

examples.en: Proper delegation of authority prevents managerial bottlenecks from strangling project growth.
examples.zh: 建立制度化的權責充分授權，能有效防範管理高層決策塞車瓶頸扼殺專案的敏捷擴張。

examples.en: The team supervisor assigned specific research topics to each member.
examples.zh: 團隊主管為每位成員指派了特定的專題研究題目。

examples.en: The editor assigned the front-page breaking news story to her star reporter.
examples.zh: 報社總編輯將頭版重大突發新聞特稿的深入採訪重任，指派給旗下最頂尖的王牌記者。

examples.en: The hotel desk clerk assigned us a quiet corner room overlooking the lush garden.
examples.zh: 飯店櫃台接待人員貼心地為我們安排了一間能俯瞰滿園翠綠花園造景的靜謐邊間套房。

examples.en: Hand in your written research assignment by 5 PM this Friday.
examples.zh: 請在本週五下午五點前繳交書面研究作業。

examples.en: Taking an overseas work assignment in Tokyo broadened his global professional perspective.
examples.zh: 勇敢接受調派赴日本東京擔任外派主管的海外派任任務，大幅拓寬了他的國際職場格局。

examples.en: The math teacher gave students a challenging problem-solving assignment over the weekend.
examples.zh: 數學老師在週末放假前給全班同學出了一份極富挑戰性、需深度動腦思辨的專題作業。

words.definition: 優先處理；排定優先順序

examples.en: Prioritize urgent customer support requests before replying to general mail.
examples.zh: 在回覆一般信件前，請先優先處理緊急的客戶支援需求。

examples.en: Working parents must learn how to prioritize family health over non-essential overtime.
examples.zh: 身兼父母重任的在職上班族必須學會取捨，將家人的身心健康排在非必要加班之上。

examples.en: When studying for exams, prioritize understanding foundational concepts before tricky edge cases.
examples.zh: 準備大考時，務必先將核心基礎概念的融會貫通排在最優先，切莫過早鑽研冷僻考題。

examples.en: Customer safety and satisfaction remain our top corporate priority.
examples.zh: 顧客的安全與滿意度始終是我們企業最首要的優先考量。

examples.en: Rescuing stranded residents took absolute priority following the mountain landslide.
examples.zh: 在高山土石流坍方事故發生後，緊急搜救受困居民具有壓倒一切的最高優先絕對級別。

examples.en: Make getting eight hours of sleep a non-negotiable priority in your daily lifestyle.
examples.zh: 將每晚睡足八小時的高品質睡眠，列為個人日常健康生活中絕不可輕易妥協的第一優先。

examples.en: The final project deliverables include software source code and user manual.
examples.zh: 專案最終的交付成果包含軟體原始碼與使用者操作手冊。

examples.en: All agreed deliverables must undergo thorough quality control before client handover.
examples.zh: 所有在合約中敲定答應的應交付項目，在正式交付客戶驗收前必須通過嚴格的品管審核。

examples.en: The consultant listed key project milestones and expected deliverables in the contract proposal.
examples.zh: 企管顧問在合約企劃書中，鉅細靡遺地羅列了各階段的關鍵里程碑與預期具體產出成果。

examples.en: We submitted a weekly progress report detailing newly completed features.
examples.zh: 我們提交了一份每週進度報告，詳列了最新開發完成的系統功能。

examples.en: The general contractor presented a monthly progress report on the skyscraper construction.
examples.zh: 營造統包工程大廠向業主呈遞了一份詳盡的月進度報告，報告摩天大樓當前的施工進展。

examples.en: Keep your progress report concise, highlighting completed goals and upcoming milestones.
examples.zh: 撰寫專案進度報告時務求重點清晰扼要，著重列出已達標的成果與即將攻堅的下階段目標。

examples.en: The engineer gave a brief 5-minute status update during morning standup.
examples.zh: 工程師在每日早晨站立會議中進行了五分鐘的簡要進度更新。

examples.en: Send me a quick status update via Slack as soon as you speak with the vendor.
examples.zh: 你一旦與外部協力廠商接洽溝通完畢，請第一時間透過 Slack 傳個簡短進度回報給我。

examples.en: Daily status updates ensure every member of the remote engineering team stays aligned.
examples.zh: 維持每日簡明扼要的現況更新，能確保分散各地的跨國軟體工程團隊永遠步調高度一致。

examples.en: I will follow up with the client regarding contract revisions tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天會主動與客戶聯繫，跟進合約修改的相關事宜。

examples.en: Doctors always follow up with recovering patients two weeks after hospital discharge.
examples.zh: 病患平安康復出院兩週後，主治醫師團隊均會依例致電病患進行例行的後續復原追蹤。

examples.en: Remember to follow up with an email thanking the interviewer for their time.
examples.zh: 面試結束步出考場後，切記在二十四小時內發送一封致謝信，感謝主考官撥冗面談。

examples.en: Schedule a follow-up meeting next Tuesday to evaluate pilot results.
examples.zh: 安排下週二召開後續追蹤會議，以評估試行計畫的成效。

examples.en: Sending a polite follow-up email bumped the delayed invoice back to the top of accounting's inbox.
examples.zh: 寄出一封言辭客氣的後續追蹤跟進郵件，順利讓延宕未付的請款發票重回會計信箱頂端。

examples.en: Routine medical follow-up exams ensure that no surgical complications develop unnoticed.
examples.zh: 術後定期回診進行例行的後續追蹤檢查，能確保任何潛在併發症不會在不知不覺中惡化。

examples.en: A fast customer feedback loop allows developers to fix bugs rapidly.
examples.zh: 敏捷快速的客戶回饋機制讓開發人員能迅速修復軟體錯誤。

examples.en: Establishing a continuous feedback loop between teachers and students boosts engagement.
examples.zh: 在師生之間建立暢通且持續的良性雙向反饋循環機制，能大幅激發課堂上的互動參與感。

examples.en: Lean startup methodology relies on tight build-measure-learn feedback loops to validate ideas.
examples.zh: 精實創業心法極度強調打造「開發—量測—學習」的高頻閉環回饋機制，藉以驗證商業模式。

examples.en: The engineering panel assessed technical feasibility before starting construction.
examples.zh: 工程專家小組在動工興建前全面評估了技術可行性。

examples.en: Insurance adjusters arrived promptly to assess vehicle damage following the highway collision.
examples.zh: 車禍理賠勘查專員第一時間趕赴車禍現場，嚴格評估國道追撞事故對車體造成的損壞。

examples.en: The university uses blind grading protocols to assess final research papers impartially.
examples.zh: 國立大學全面採行雙向匿名盲審評分規範，以求徹頭徹尾客觀公正地評定學期專題論文。

examples.en: Conduct a thorough risk assessment before entering emerging markets.
examples.zh: 在進軍新興市場前，請務必進行全方位的風險評估。

examples.en: Formative classroom assessments help teachers identify which grammar topics require review.
examples.zh: 課堂形成性隨堂評量能有效協助授課教師精準診斷，究竟哪些核心文法章節亟待補強複習。

examples.en: The environmental impact assessment concluded that the solar farm posed minimal eco-threats.
examples.zh: 該項環境影響評估審查報告最終裁定，這座大型太陽能發電廠對周邊生態衝擊極其微小。

examples.en: Outdated server hardware became a major performance bottleneck.
examples.zh: 老舊的伺服器硬體成為了系統整體效能的主要瓶頸。

examples.en: Road construction narrowed the busy avenue down to a single lane, creating a severe traffic bottleneck.
examples.zh: 道路開挖施工將原本寬闊的主要幹道縮減為單線通車，造成了極其嚴重的交通瓶頸。

examples.en: Senior management approval delays became the primary bottleneck slowing down app deployment.
examples.zh: 高階管理決策層層核決的冗長延宕，成為了嚴重拖垮行動應用程式正式部署上線的首要瓶頸。

words.definition: 應變計畫；備用方案 (Plan B)

examples.en: Event organizers prepared a contingency plan in case of outdoor rain.
examples.zh: 活動主辦單位準備了完善的雨天應變備用計畫。

examples.en: Every nuclear plant operates with a multi-layered emergency contingency plan.
examples.zh: 每一座核能發電廠均配備並定期演練極其嚴密的多層次全方位緊急災害應變計畫。

examples.en: Always maintain a flexible contingency plan when traveling abroad during volatile monsoon seasons.
examples.zh: 在氣候捉摸不定的梅雨與季風季節赴海外自助旅行時，務必隨時備妥一套彈性應變方案。

words.definition: 精簡；使效率化；簡化流程

examples.en: We streamlined the checkout process to improve online customer conversion.
examples.zh: 我們精簡了結帳付款流程以提升線上顧客的購買轉換率。

examples.en: Upgrading to cloud invoicing helped the company streamline accounting procedures significantly.
examples.zh: 全面導入雲端電子發票開立系統，協助企業顯著精簡了繁複耗時的會計日常沖銷作業。

examples.en: Modern aerodynamic car bodies are shaped to streamline airflow and reduce highway drag.
examples.zh: 當代符合空氣動力學的高鐵與汽車流線型外觀，旨在優化氣流通過並大幅降低風阻。

examples.en: Successful policy implementation requires broad community support.
examples.zh: 政策要能成功落實執行，需要獲得社會大眾廣泛的支持。

examples.en: The rapid implementation of online learning platforms kept classrooms running during epidemics.
examples.zh: 迅速落地實行遠距線上教學平台，確保了重大公衛疫情停課期間各級學校依然停課不停學。

examples.en: Thorough staff training is crucial during the implementation phase of new enterprise software.
examples.zh: 在導入全新型企業大型 ERP 軟體的實施階段中，對全體第一線同仁落實扎實教育訓練至關重要。

examples.en: The hospital implemented a new electronic health record system.
examples.zh: 該醫院全面實施導入了全新的電子病歷系統。

examples.en: The city government implemented strict anti-idling vehicle regulations to clean urban air.
examples.zh: 市政主管機關嚴格實施並貫徹怠速熄火管制條例，以全面淨化都會區街道的空氣品質。

examples.en: Security teams must immediately implement security patches to safeguard company servers.
examples.zh: 資安應變小組必須第一時間緊急部署並實施各項資安修補程式，保護公司伺服器免遭入侵。

words.definition: 基準；標竿；進行基準測試

examples.en: Our battery life benchmark exceeded that of competing smartphones.
examples.zh: 我們的電池續航力基準測試數據超越了同級競爭的手機品牌。

examples.en: Taiwan's world-class National Health Insurance system is revered as a global public healthcare benchmark.
examples.zh: 台灣首屈一指的健保制度被國際公共衛生領域奉為兼顧普惠與高效率的世界級標竿。

examples.en: Engineers run specialized diagnostic scripts to benchmark processor performance under extreme loads.
examples.zh: 晶片架構工程師運行專業的系統診斷腳本，在高壓滿載情境下對處理器效能進行基準測試。
